chunks: I heard Abu Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) saying: “No one among the people claimed that he had compiled the Qur'an in its entirety as it was revealed except a liar; and none compiled it and preserved it as Allah, the Exalted, sent it down, except ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib (عليه السلام) and the Imams after him (عليهم السلام).”

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: the Imams, the divinely designated leaders from the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.الْقُرْآنَ: the Qur'an, the divine revelation sent down by Allah
key_terms.حَفِظَهُ: preserved it and retained it accurately
key_terms.كَذَّابٌ: a liar; one making a false claim

ai.seo_question: Who compiled and preserved the Qur'an exactly as it was revealed according to Imam al-Baqir (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the complete collection and preservation of the Qur'an exactly as revealed is a distinction belonging to ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib (عليه السلام) and the Imams (عليهم السلام) after him. It emphasizes the unique knowledge and authority of the Ahl al-Bayt (عليهم السلام) regarding the Qur'an.
